|gr1= High Command

|descr= Returns group icons params used for command bar drawing such as color, text, scale, visibility, waypoint visibility, waypoint color.

|s1= [[getGroupIconParams]] group

|p1= group: [[Group]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [color, text, scale, visibility, WPvisibility, WPcolor]
* color: [[Color|Color (RGB)]] - icon color
* text: [[String]] - icon text
* scale: [[Number]] - icon scale
* visibility: [[Boolean]] - icon visibility
* WPvisibility: [[Boolean]] - waypoint visibility
* WPcolor: [[Color|Color (RGB)]] - waypoint color

|x1= <sqf>_iconParams = getGroupIconParams group player;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>getGroupIconParams group player params ["_color", "_text", "_scale", "_visibility", "_WPVisibility", "_WPColor"];</sqf>
